title: MAC: A Benchmark for Multiple Attributes Compositional Zero-Shot Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how single-attribute labeling in existing datasets misguides model evaluation by falsely penalizing correct but unlabeled attributes, and mitigating this by constructing a comprehensive multi-attribute benchmark.

Analyzing the proportion of CLIP-suggested attributes in the final dataset and performing an ablation study (retraining the model with raw CLIP suggestions) to verify that the dataset is not dominated by the biases of the CLIP model used during annotation.
